fields.name: license_tier_classifications
fields.description: Named tiers or classifications of licensure available within the profession, reflecting different levels of education, experience, and authorized scope.
fields.sample_quote: The division shall issue to a person who qualifies under this chapter a license in the classification of: (a) master therapeutic recreation specialist; (b) therapeutic recreation specialist; or (c) therapeutic recreation technician.

fields.name: assistant_tier_available
fields.description: Whether the state recognizes a sub-therapist assistant or technician license tier distinct from the full therapist license.
fields.sample_quote: Licensed recreational therapy assistant. - A person who holds a license pursuant to this Chapter as a recreational therapy assistant to act under the supervision of a licensed recreational therapist as defined by rule.

fields.name: aide_tier_available
fields.description: Whether the state recognizes an unlicensed aide role that may perform limited tasks under direct on-site supervision.
fields.sample_quote: Recreational therapy aide. - Any nonlicensed person who aids in the provision of recreational therapy services under the provisions of this Chapter, and who acts under the direction and on-site supervision of a licensed recreational therapist or licensed recreational therapy assistant.

fields.name: credential_type
fields.description: The formal credential type issued by the state to authorize practice.
fields.sample_quote: 'Registration' means the registration issued to a person under this chapter.

fields.name: nctrc_certification_accepted_in_lieu_of_exam
fields.description: Whether holding an active NCTRC Certified Therapeutic Recreation Specialist (CTRS) credential can substitute for or satisfy the state examination requirement.
fields.sample_quote: document proof of current certification in good standing as a Certified Therapeutic Recreation Specialist by the National Council for Therapeutic Recreation Certification, or an equivalence of that certification, as determined by division rule made in consultation with the board.

fields.name: nctrc_continuing_education_accepted
fields.description: Whether continuing education programs meeting NCTRC recertification standards are accepted toward state renewal requirements.
fields.sample_quote: The executive director, in consultation with the advisory board, shall accept continuing education programs that meet the recertification standards of the National Council for Therapeutic Recreation Certification.

fields.name: scope_job_analysis_reference
fields.description: Whether the state explicitly references the NCTRC Job Analysis Study as the authoritative basis for defining scope of practice.
fields.sample_quote: The practice of recreational therapy includes all direct patient or client services... representing the process and knowledge base delineated in the most recent National Council for Therapeutic Recreation Certification (NCTRC) Job Analysis Study and professional standards of practice.

fields.name: authorized_practice_settings
fields.category: where and how services may be delivered
fields.description: Explicit list of settings in which a licensee is authorized to practice recreational therapy.
fields.sample_quote: A person licensed as a 'Recreational Therapist' under this Chapter may practice in clinical, residential, educational, and community settings.

fields.name: private_practice_authorized
fields.category: where and how services may be delivered
fields.description: Whether the licensee is explicitly authorized to practice in private practice (as opposed to only institutional or supervised employment settings).
fields.sample_quote: A master therapeutic recreation specialist licensed under this chapter may: (a) practice recreational therapy: ... (ii) in private practice; or (iii) as a consultant.

fields.name: referral_required_for_treatment
fields.category: where and how services may be delivered
fields.description: Whether a referral from a qualified health care professional is required before initiating recreational therapy services for individuals with medically-related conditions.
fields.sample_quote: Initiation of recreational therapy services to individuals with medically-related conditions shall be based on a referral from any qualified health care professional who, within the scope of the professional's licensure, is authorized to refer for health care services.

fields.name: referral_exempt_services
fields.category: where and how services may be delivered
fields.description: Categories of services explicitly exempted from the referral requirement.
fields.sample_quote: Prevention, wellness, education, adaptive sports and recreation, and related services shall not require a referral.

fields.name: adaptive_equipment_authorized
fields.category: what therapists are specifically allowed to do
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly authorizes identifying, designing, fabricating, applying, or training in the use of adaptive recreational equipment.
fields.sample_quote: Identifying, designing, fabricating, applying, or training in the use of, adaptive recreational equipment.

fields.name: community_integration_services_authorized
fields.category: what therapists are specifically allowed to do
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly authorizes community integration, reintegration, inclusion, and transitioning services.
fields.sample_quote: Providing community integration, reintegration, inclusion, and transitioning services to maximize health and participation in play, recreation, leisure, and related community activities.

fields.name: leisure_education_and_counseling_authorized
fields.category: what therapists are specifically allowed to do
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly authorizes leisure education and counseling as a distinct service within scope of practice.
fields.sample_quote: Providing leisure education and counseling to address issues that hinder health and engagement in play, recreation, leisure, and related community activities.

fields.name: pain_management_modalities_authorized
fields.category: what therapists are specifically allowed to do
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly authorizes non-invasive and non-pharmacological approaches to reduce or alleviate pain as part of recreational therapy services.
fields.sample_quote: Identifying, applying, and evaluating the use of non-invasive and non-pharmacological approaches to reduce or alleviate pain or manage pain to minimize its impact upon participation.

fields.name: discharge_planning_authorized
fields.category: what therapists are specifically allowed to do
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly authorizes developing a discharge or transition plan in collaboration with the patient, family, and treatment team.
fields.sample_quote: Developing a discharge plan in collaboration with the individual, the individual's family, and other treatment team members.

fields.name: supervision_required_for_assistant_tier
fields.description: Whether the statute requires assistant- or technician-tier licensees to practice under the supervision of a higher-tier licensed recreational therapist.
fields.sample_quote: A therapeutic recreation technician: (a) may perform recreational therapy services if: (i) under the supervision of a master therapeutic recreation specialist or a therapeutic recreation specialist employed full-time and on-site in the same hospital, clinic, or facility.

fields.name: delegation_coercion_prohibited
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly prohibits coercing a licensed recreational therapist into delegating tasks when the therapist determines delegation would compromise client safety.
fields.sample_quote: No person shall coerce a licensed recreational therapist into compromising client safety by requiring the licensed recreational therapist to delegate activities or tasks if the licensed recreational therapist determines that it is inappropriate to do so.

fields.name: technician_assessment_limitations
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly restricts the technician or assistant tier from performing the interpretive or analytical portion of patient assessment.
fields.sample_quote: A therapeutic recreation technician: ... (d) may not perform the portion of an assessment described in Subsection 58-40-102(2)(a)(ii) [interpreting and analyzing collected data].

fields.name: privileged_communications_protection
fields.description: Whether the statute places therapist-client communications on the same privileged legal basis as physician-patient communications.
fields.sample_quote: The confidential communications between licensed recreational therapists and their clients or patients is placed on the same legal basis as those between physician and patient, and except as otherwise provided by law, no recreational therapist shall be required to disclose such privileged communications.

fields.name: patient_privacy_duty
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly imposes a duty on licensees to safeguard a patient's right to privacy regarding identity, condition, diagnosis, and personal effects.
fields.sample_quote: Failing to safeguard a person's right to privacy as to the person's identity, condition, diagnosis, personal effects, or other matters about which the licensee is privileged to know from providing recreational therapy services.

fields.name: suicide_prevention_training_required
fields.description: Whether the statute mandates a minimum number of hours of suicide prevention training as a condition of initial licensure or license renewal.
fields.sample_quote: The division shall require a licensee, as a condition of renewal of the licensee's license, to complete a minimum of two hours of training in suicide prevention via a course that the division designates as approved.

fields.name: suicide_prevention_training_hours
fields.description: Minimum number of hours of suicide prevention training required by statute for licensure or renewal.
fields.sample_quote: complete a minimum of two hours of training in suicide prevention via a course that the division designates as approved.

fields.name: treatment_plan_documentation_required
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly requires a written individualized treatment or intervention plan to be maintained for each patient receiving recreational therapy services.
fields.sample_quote: A recreational therapy treatment or intervention plan shall be maintained for each patient receiving recreational therapy services under this chapter.

fields.name: authorized_title_abbreviations
fields.category: professional title and credential display rules
fields.description: Specific letter abbreviations or title designations that licensed practitioners are authorized or prohibited from using.
fields.sample_quote: Licensed recreational therapists may use the letters 'TR,' 'TRS,' and 'CTRS/L' in connection with their name or place of business.

fields.name: recreational_activity_exemption
fields.category: professional title and credential display rules
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly exempts persons conducting recreational activities for purely recreational (non-therapeutic) purposes from licensure requirements.
fields.sample_quote: A person may conduct or participate in a recreational activity without being licensed under this chapter if the person is using the recreational activity for the sole outcome of the recreational experience and is not using recreational activity as a therapeutic intervention following the therapeutic recreation process.
